title: Sources & further reading
body:
Restaurant prices, booking rules and party-size limits came from each venue's own pages — RyuGin's course price, seating, allergy and cancellation policy and reservation route; Ginza Ukai-tei and its booking form; Kobikicho Ohno; TableCheck listings for Aragawa and Yakiniku Ushigoro; HotPepper Gourmet listings for Torien and Uobei Genki Sushi.

Entry rules from Japan National Tourism Organization (mofa.go.jp itself blocked automated verification — reconfirm there before departure). Transit fares from PASMO, Keisei Skyliner, the Tokyo Monorail fare table, and the Haneda access guide (whose Keikyu fares are published only as a PDF). ATM guidance from Seven Bank. Tipping and dining etiquette from JNTO and Japan Guide; the Nov 1, 2026 tax-free system change from JNTO.

Sight hours and prices from each venue's own site — Senso-ji, Meiji Jingu (forest history from its own forest page), teamLab Planets, Shinjuku Gyoen, and Tokyo Tower.

Market opening days from the Tsukiji Outer Market business-day calendar — which states its shops run on the Tokyo Central Wholesale Market calendar — the market's own visiting guidance, and the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market for Toyosu. Crowd timing at Tsukiji and Ameyoko is corroborated by independent firsthand accounts, several Japanese-language. Ameya-Yokocho's shop count and area from its own site. Public holidays from the Cabinet Office's own calendar.
